## {#play}

{{< game-picker >}}

::: notes
Choose a game along the top, then a unit (or all units). Every game uses that unit's vocab, and 🔀 gives a new word, picture, board or set of questions. The page remembers your last choice on this computer. Between classes, press **W** and **↺ Reset for the next class**.

To put one of these games in your own slide deck, see the *Greek Word Games* deck in Unit 1.
:::
